**Calculation:**
- FY2024 gross profit = $245,122M − $74,114M = $171,008M → gross margin = 171,008 / 245,122 ≈ 69.8% [DOC-1]
- FY2023 gross profit = $211,915M − $65,863M = $146,052M → gross margin = 146,052 / 211,915 ≈ 68.9% [DOC-1]

**Change:** 69.8% − 68.9% ≈ +0.8 percentage points, indicating gross margin improved from FY2023 to FY2024.

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points (from ~68.9% in FY2023 to ~69.8% in FY2024)
